---
title: Plain
citation:
  title: >
    A folded
    *title*
author: Jane Doe
date: 2025-04-30
google-scholar: true
appendix-cite-as: [display, bibtex]
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_title"][content="A folded title"]']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-appendix-citeas em']
        matches: ['Title']
---

A folded block scalar `citation: title:` keeps its formatting and has no newline in the metadata.
